# DEVSYNX

> DEVSYNX Private Limited is a premier software development, AI automation, and technical SEO engineering company. It builds custom software, autonomous AI agents, high-performance Next.js web applications, mobile apps, and multi-tenant SaaS products for clients across the United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Germany, Canada, Australia, and Pakistan.

Contact: info@devsynx.com, phone and WhatsApp +92 302 946 2542. Primary engineering hub: Islamabad, Pakistan. Founder and CEO: Syed Hassan Ali Shah. Clients served: 300+.

## Global Hubs & Target Markets
- [United States Software Development](https://devsynx.com/usa/): dedicated squads with 5+ hours daily EST/PST overlap and USD pricing
- [United Kingdom Software Development](https://devsynx.com/uk/): GDPR-compliant bespoke web, mobile & AI development for London & UK teams
- [UAE & Dubai Software Development](https://devsynx.com/uae/): bilingual Arabic/English web apps, mobile solutions & AI for Dubai & Abu Dhabi
- [Germany Software Development](https://devsynx.com/germany/): high-precision software engineering, clean code & AI automation with CET overlap
- [Canada Software Development](https://devsynx.com/canada/): dedicated engineering pods for Toronto, Vancouver & Montreal tech companies
- [Australia Software Development](https://devsynx.com/australia/): overnight engineering velocity and custom software for Sydney & Melbourne
